capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Cadillac IQL release as relayed by Wards: 205 kWh from the 24-module battery shared with the Escalade IQ (also Cars.com IQL, TheDrive, Motor Authority). Read as usable, see the Escalade IQ powertrain. Guide Auto (Canada) says 200 kWh. Fact-check: no page says "usable" outright; GM says "more than 200 kWh of available energy" (owner check).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: GM Ultium 24-module pack uses NCMA (nickel-cobalt-manganese-aluminum) pouch cells from Ultium Cells (closest enum nmc); same pack family as the Silverado EV Max / Hummer 24-module pack. The page does not itself list the Escalade IQ among vehicles using it, so confirm with GM.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: IQL uses the same 24-module pack as the IQ (Wards), and GM says the IQ pack enables 800-volt DC fast charging.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Cadillac support page (cadillac.com returns 403; read as a search excerpt only): routing to a DC fast charger with Google built-in navigation automatically preconditions the battery, and the Cadillac app offers a manual Fast Charge Prep. Lineup-wide Cadillac EV feature, not read on an Escalade IQ page. UNVERIFIED for this model. Fact-check: support page excerpt is not Escalade-specific and says manual conditioning is "if equipped".

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same pack and charger hardware as the 2026 IQ (350 kW per Cadillac); the IQL release gives about 116 miles in 10 min (Wards), no kW figure.

ac_max_kw.notes: IQL: 11.5 kW standard, 19.2 kW available (Cars.com, relaying Cadillac); 19.2 kW on every IQL from 2027 (InsideEVs, TTAC). The powertrain value is the maximum; the lower trims are set per trim.
